svg.title: Women's flight cap, officer (silver and blue braid)
svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"hat-flight-cap-women-officer","name":"Women's flight cap, officer (silver and blue braid)","size_in":{"w":12.27,"h":5.03},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,1227,503],"size_source":"measured","size_basis":"Measured from CAPR 39-1 Fig A5-9 \"FLIGHT CAPS\" (3 March 2020, p.140) at 157 px/in from the figure's own 1 1/2 in marks. Cap body 12.03 x 4.79 in plus 0.12 in margin. The regulation gives no cap dimensions; real caps vary by size. (Earlier build used the flatter p.139 side silhouette, 11.6 x 3.65 in.)","anchors":{"top_center":[613.5,0],"bottom_center":[613.5,503],"center":[613.5,251.5],"left_edge":[0,251.5],"right_edge":[1227,251.5],"front_edge_center":[12,359.2],"device_slot_center":[162,259.4],"braid_front":[12,155.1],"garment_attach_center":[613.5,503]},"landmarks":{"device_slot":{"x":112,"y":209.4,"w":100,"h":100}},"landmarks_note":"rects are {x,y,w,h} in user units (0.01 in); device_slot is a nominal 1 in box centred on the device position (the device itself is 1.15-1.36 in, see the cap-device-* assets)","orientation":"side view, front of cap at left (wearer facing left), wearer's left flap shown; sloped crown: tall at the front, lower at the rear (Fig A5-9)","documented":["flight cap device on the front left flap, centred halfway between top and bottom of the flap, 1 1/2 in from the front of the cap (6.2.2.2.1-3)","Field grade, company grade and flight officers (6.2.2.2.5)","general officers silver braid; other officers silver and blue braid; NCOs and cadets plain blue (6.2.2.2.4-6)","worn slightly to the wearer's right, about one inch above the eyebrows (6.2.2.1)"],"assumed":["braid band width and position (about 0.33 of cap height below the top edge, read off the figure)","navy colour sampled from the figure","shading","figure caps differ slightly in height, each variant keeps its own measured outline"],"fit":{"method":"per-column profile of the regulation figure","score":null},"grade":"accessory","provenance":"outline per column from Fig A5-9 (sloped crown, fold line, curtain); braid line traced from the figure; navy and braid colours sampled","colours":{"navy":"#0b1f5e","navyD":"#06143f","braid_silver":"#d4d8de","braid_blue":"#2c4fb0"},"braid":"field grade, company grade and flight officers: silver and blue braid (6.2.2.2.5)"}
